verdict.rationale: Stripe's seller docs say agent orders appear on the Dashboard Transactions page tagged with the originating agent, and sellers can filter transactions by agent name. The CheckoutSessions.PaymentIntent.agent_details field also exposes attribution programmatically. Missing for 10: documented reporting or export broken down by agent beyond Dashboard filtering, general availability of the agent_details API field (currently private preview), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
